## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List checks and results. Distinguish unit fixtures, headless guests, and UTM
interaction; include relevant versions and known gaps.

## Review notes

- Explain changes to networking, permissions, verification, sandboxing, or privacy defaults.
- Identify upstream-derived material, pinned revisions, and license/notice updates.
- Confirm submitted evidence is sanitized and contains no guest state or credentials.
